description:
Let's make donuts on the Nintendo Switch™!
Fry up donuts in a variety of shapes and add the toppings your customers crave!
An expert donut maker always leaves their customers satisfied!
Share Joy-Con™, and up to 4 players can join in!
Reach for the ultimate high score!

《Rules》
Make donuts with the shapes and toppings that your customers request!
Keep a close eye on the donuts and don't let them fry too long!
Make as many donuts as you can within the time limit!

《How to Play》
1. Add donuts to the fryer!

2. Flip them over when one side is cooked!

3. When both sides are fully fried, add toppings and serve it up!

[Score Attack]
Race against the clock to fill customer orders, reach a new personal best score, and compete with others on the global leaderboard!

[Battle]
Test your donut-making skills in a battle with up to 4 players!
Speed and accuracy are the keys to victory!
name: Make it! Donut
intro:
Get ready for a delicious donut-making challenge!
Make as many as you can and watch your food cart prosper!
